page.overview:
Who is Nolan's partner?

Nolan's partner was a minor character in Invincible, debuting in Season 2's flashbacks.

She was a Viltrumite warrior of the Viltrum Empire, she was once the first known partner of “The Great Nolan” during his early conquests. Loyal to the Viltrumite mission of universal domination, she fought alongside Nolan on various assignments. However, during a mission on the Savage Planet, she was swiftly killed by a Rognarr, marking a brutal and sudden end to her role in the empire.

Her personality remains largely unknown. However, she was once a comrade to the Great Nolan. During a mission to the Savage Planet, she was unexpectedly killed by one of the Rognarrs before she had a chance to react.

Despite her extremely old age by human standards, she had appeared as a young woman with a fair, slightly tanned complexion. She had striking green eyes and a relatively slender build, distinguishing her from many of her fellow Viltrumites who typically exhibited more muscular and athletic physiques.
